name: S2MetNet
description: A dataset and deep-learning benchmark for quantifying methane point sources using Sentinel-2 satellite imagery.
general_score_metric: mean_absolute_error (for emission quantification) and average_precision (for source detection)
reputation: A niche, recent remote-sensing benchmark valued by researchers working on methane detection from multispectral imagery but not yet a broad community standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; limited number of labeled point sources and scene diversity; methane signals are subtle in Sentinel-2 bands (spectral and spatial resolution limits); potential class imbalance and geospatial/generalization challenges.
